description: This Java class defines constants and an enum related to device connection operations within the Eclipse Hono project. It includes string constants for fields, endpoint identifiers, and address names, as well as an enum representing specific device connection actions with associated utility methods.

classes.name: DeviceConnectionConstants
classes.description: A final class that provides constants and utility methods for device connection operations, extending RequestResponseApiConstants.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns the subject string associated with the device connection action.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Constructs a DeviceConnectionAction enum value from a given subject string.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if a given subject string corresponds to a valid DeviceConnectionAction.
